items.title: 'Didn't have the balls': Hume takes shot at Labor after shocking Coalition loss
items.description: Deputy Liberal leader Jane Hume is promising a new day for a Coalition that has lost its way but whether the party can recover from the wreckage of Farrer remains to be seen.

items.title: The university where teaching is tougher than having terminal cancer for this academic
items.description: The University of Newcastle has been found to be worst in class when it comes to staff wellbeing. Now, an academic with terminal cancer is speaking out about it because others fear they cannot.

items.title: 'Closure': Police believe body found in NSW is alleged triple murderer
items.description: A body has been found near Lake Cargelligo, where three people were shot and killed in January this year, sparking a massive manhunt.

items.title: Man charged with White House correspondents' dinner shooting pleads not guilty
items.description: Cole Tomas Allen, 31, has been charged with attempting to assassinate US president Donald Trump at the April dinner.

items.title: US-Iran ceasefire 'on life support' with energy woes to continue in 2027
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he's aiming for "complete victory" in Iran as the US and Iran reach an impasse in negotiations.

items.title: Hantavirus-hit cruise ship passengers to quarantine in Perth
items.description: Australian passengers who were on board the hantavirus-hit cruise ship will be ordered to quarantine in Perth for at least three weeks.

items.title: No link between PCOS and higher rate of abnormal cysts: study
items.description: Despite what the name suggests, women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) do not have a higher rate of abnormal ovarian cysts than the general population, a large study shows.

items.title: Man charged after allegedly making threats at north Brisbane mosque
items.description: Masjid Taqwa's board said the alleged incident caused fear and distress among members of the congregation.

items.title: Dua Lipa sues Samsung for using her face to sell TVs
items.description: The lawsuit alleges Samsung featured a copyrighted image of the pop star on the front of cardboard boxes containing televisions for sale.

items.title: Boy in critical condition after being hit by train at Melbourne station
items.description: A year 7 student is fighting for his life in hospital after being hit by a train and becoming trapped for up to an hour.

items.title: ICC arrest warrant for Philippine Senator Roland Dela Rosa over war on drugs
items.description: Video footage displayed during the Senate session showed Philippine senator Roland Dela Rosa running away from Philippine agents as the International Criminal Court confirmed an arrest warrant had been issued.

items.title: Everything we know so far about the federal budget
items.description: Budget night features a lot of political talk and policy wonkiness, but the government's plan will impact your financial situation in one way or another, so it's quite important. Here's what you need to know.

items.title: Why are people trying to raid Scientology buildings around the world?
items.description: Over the weekend, Brisbane's Church of Scientology became the latest target of a viral trend that began in the United States just a few months ago — the Scientology speed run.

items.title: Alleged Russian spies to face fresh espionage conspiracy charge
items.description: Australian citizens Kira and Igor Korolev were charged in 2024, accused of attempting to gather and send state secrets to Russia.

items.title: Indulgent breakfast recipes to enjoy at home
items.description: From shakshuka to French toast, you can enjoy an indulgent breakfast or brunch at home with one of these recipes.

items.title: 'Got no friends left': Jewish teen bullied while playing Minecraft
items.description: The Royal Commission into Antisemitism and Social Cohesion hears a 15-year-old was subjected to antisemitic slurs while playing the popular video game with students from a Perth school.

items.title: 'Premature': One Nation's chances in Sydney's west played down
items.description: One Nation's Barnaby Joyce says potential candidates for Western Sydney were first and second-generation Australians, but an analyst calls him a "great media performer".

items.title: Lucky endangered quoll survives 600km hitchhike in Qld
items.description: Members of the public spotted the marsupial fleeing the wheel arch of a truck in Brisbane and alerted authorities.

items.title: Aboriginal graffiti artist remorseful for sacred site desecration
items.description: An Aboriginal man has pleaded guilty to vandalising a culturally significant site in Victoria's Alpine National Park.

items.title: Some universities regain access to Canvas as hacker's deadline looms
items.description: Australian universities and education departments have begun regaining access to online learning platform Canvas, after being caught up in a breach last week. However, the deadline set by the hackers continues to count down.

items.title: Crows footballer tells fans to 'choose kindness' after social media abuse
items.description: Adelaide Crows footballer Josh Rachele has called out fan behaviour after receiving an abusive message online amid an ongoing conversation on mental health in the AFL.

items.title: 'I can't believe we did this': The joy of having babies in your 40s
items.description: Whether it's about overcoming health challenges, waiting to meet "the right person" or wanting to be financially stable, Australian women are increasingly having children later in life.

items.title: 'Carrot hazard' slows traffic on Tasmanian highway
items.description: Thousands of carrots have spilled onto a Tasmanian highway, causing a traffic hazard, with police calling for public help to find the driver involved.

items.title: Netballer cops 'hurtful' criticism for returning 10 weeks post-baby
items.description: Paige Hadley made a shock return to the Super Netball league less than two months after giving birth to her baby boy. Despite some commentary online questioning her priorities, the midcourter is more determined than ever to prove women can pursue multiple dreams.

items.title: Hasrat's life changed the day she stumbled across the T20 World Cup
items.description: State and WBBL cricketer Hasrat Gill has risen through the ranks of youth Australian cricket. She is one of many South Asian teenagers flocking to the sport.
